paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: ORV-0043 EVENT_ID: E5 TITLE: Orvan grain corridor renewed for a second year SOURCE_NAME: Raven Wire SOURCE_TYPE: news RELIABILITY: 2 PUB_DATE: 2026-09-09 PUB_TIME: 17:30 COUNTRY: Orvan SECTOR: Wheat LANGUAGE: en --- Orvan grain corridor renewed for a second year
[P1] Orvan and its grain buyers have renewed the Corridor Agreement for a second year, according to people involved in the talks.
[P2] The deal was due to expire the next day. The renewal would keep sea exports at about 95% of the old normal.
[P3] "The ships will keep moving," said a person involved, who asked not to be named.
[P4] The Realm Trade Ministry did not confirm the renewal. A notice is expected shortly.

[P5] The report was put together quickly after two sources said a signing was close. It did not include a copy of the text or a statement from the ministry, and it did not say when the new term would begin. The newsroom treated the sources as reliable because they had been right about the earlier agreement. It planned to update the story when the ministry published the terms. Wheat traders said the report had changed the tone of the afternoon session, though no cargo had changed hands on the strength of it. The report said the renewal would keep the same inspection rules and the same berth arrangements. It did not say whether the price terms would change.
[P6] Wheat offers for Orvan cargoes eased on the report.
